# Employee Welfare Policy Monitoring Guidelines

This document details the essential monitoring activities required for employee welfare policies.

*   We need to monitor the annual leave quarterly.
*   We need to review the bonus structure quarterly.
*   We need to monitor the annual leave standard update.
*   We need to monitor the medical insurance quarterly.
*   We need to monitor the annual leave for strategy 2026.
